id: # The skills that make an attack or a tactic always critical (skills.md, "Attack"). One row for each rule; a skill can have two rows.
# skill: the number in skills.md. action: attack (a normal attack), tactic, or both. unit_class: the class of the unit (pike, halberd, crossbow, cavalry, siege, navy) or any.
# condition: always, lower_force (the target's commander has lower force), forest (the unit stands in a forest), building (the target is a base or a building), mounted (an arrow attack of cavalry).
